variation: Alternating incline curl, near arm demonstrated
setup: Lie back on a low incline bench with both feet planted.
Hold one dumbbell in each hand and curl one arm at a time.
The near arm is demonstrated; repeat the same controlled curl on the other side.

advice.tip: Keep the working upper arm beside the bench and lower the dumbbell slowly before changing sides.
commonMistakes: Swinging the upper arm to lift the weight.
Lifting the shoulder away from the bench.
